 import plotly.graph_objects as go

data = {
    'Year': [2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019],

    'Air Cargo Logistics': [18.9, 19.3, 19.8, 20.3, 20.9, 21.4, 22.0, 22.6, 23.2, 23.8],

    stackgroup='one',
    line=dict(width=0.5, color='#d62728')

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=data['Year'],
    y=data['Air Cargo Logistics'],

))
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=data['Year'],
    y=data['Heavy Road Freight'],
    mode='lines',
    name='Heavy Road Freight',
    stackgroup='one',
    line=dict(width=0.5, color='#2ca02c')
))
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=data['Year'],
    y=data['Domestic Passenger Air'],
    mode='lines',
    name='Domestic Passenger Air',
    stackgroup='one',
    line=dict(width=0.5, color='#1f77b4')
))
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=data['Year'],
    y=data['International Passenger Air'],
    mode='lines',
    name='International Passenger Air',
    stackgroup='one',
    line=dict(width=0.5, color='#9467bd')
))
fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=data['Year'],
    y=data['Oil Pipeline Transport'],

SUMMARY
 The image is an area chart illustrating the annual economic impact of various transportation sectors in Lebanon from 2010 to 2019. The chart features a stacked design, where each sector's contribution is layered on top of the others, allowing for a cumulative view of their combined economic impact over time. The x-axis represents the years from 2010 to 2019, while the y-axis measures the annual economic impact in billion USD, ranging from 0 to 100 billion.

The chart includes six distinct transportation sectors, each represented by a different color. Maritime Shipping, shown in blue, consistently contributes the largest economic impact, starting at approximately 14.5 billion USD in 2010 and gradually increasing to around 19.6 billion USD by 2019. The green area represents Heavy Road Freight, which starts at 8.3 billion USD in 2010 and grows to 10.8 billion USD by 2019. Finally, Oil Pipeline Transport, depicted in a muted brown, starts at 9.1 billion USD in 2010 and rises to 12.0 billion USD in 2019. The cumulative economic impact of all sectors combined reaches nearly 100 billion USD by 2019, demonstrating steady growth across the decade. The chart's title and legend at the top provide clear context and identification for each sector.

p = Path("chart.py")
source = p.read_text()
source = source.replace(
    "'Air Cargo Logistics': [18.9, 19.3, 19.8, 20.3, 20.9, 21.4, 22.0, 22.6, 23.2, 23.8]",
    "'Air Cargo Logistics': [10.2, 10.8, 11.1, 11.5, 11.9, 12.3, 12.8, 13.2, 13.7, 14.1]"
).replace(
    "'International Passenger Air': [10.2, 10.8, 11.1, 11.5, 11.9, 12.3, 12.8, 13.2, 13.7, 14.1]",
    "'International Passenger Air': [18.9, 19.3, 19.8, 20.3, 20.9, 21.4, 22.0, 22.6, 23.2, 23.8]"
)
source = source.replace("color='#d62728'", "color='TEMP_BLUE'")
source = source.replace("color='#1f77b4'", "color='#d62728'")
source = source.replace("color='TEMP_BLUE'", "color='#1f77b4'")
source = source.replace("color='#9467bd'", "color='#c49c94'")
source = source.replace("Annual Transportation Volume (Million Tonnes)",
                        "Annual Economic Impact (Billion USD)")
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source, "chart.py", "exec"))
for trace in fig.data:
    assert list(trace.y) == df[trace.name].tolist()
    assert list(trace.x) == df["Year"].tolist()
    print(trace.name, trace.line.color, list(trace.y))
print("Y-axis:", fig.layout.yaxis.title.text)
print("Layout:", fig.layout.width, fig.layout.height, fig.layout.title.text)
